knownWarning.note: Push output reported a Dependabot warning on the default branch. Detailed alert metadata was not reachable from this Codex shell.

runtimeCritical.description: Alerts affecting production runtime packages or build output. Must be identified from Dependabot package metadata before upgrades begin.
blockers: Dependabot alert package metadata is unavailable from this shell because GitHub access is blocked; category counts stay pending until the GitHub UI or API can be queried.

devOnly.description: Alerts isolated to test, lint, build, or local tooling packages. Keep separate from acceptance proof unless they block verification.
blockers: Dependabot alert package metadata is unavailable from this shell because GitHub access is blocked; category counts stay pending until the GitHub UI or API can be queried.

transitive.description: Alerts brought in through nested dependencies. Prefer minimal parent-package updates after runtime-critical scope is known.
blockers: Dependabot alert package metadata is unavailable from this shell because GitHub access is blocked; category counts stay pending until the GitHub UI or API can be queried.

blockedDeferred.description: All known alerts remain deferred as a metadata-only audit lane until GitHub Dependabot details are reachable.
blockers: Dependabot alert package metadata is unavailable from this shell because GitHub access is blocked; category counts stay pending until the GitHub UI or API can be queried.

blocked: GitHub Dependabot alert details are not reachable from this Codex shell.
No dependency upgrades were performed in this acceptance tranche.
Run the GitHub Dependabot UI or API from a network-enabled session to fill package names, vulnerable ranges, patched ranges, and direct/transitive ownership.
nextCommand: Review GitHub Dependabot metadata, classify alerts into runtime-critical, dev-only, transitive, and blocked/deferred, then run npm run verify after any minimal package update.
